requirements: Preserve original thresholds and parent checkpoints; freeze protocol before any new experiment.
Compare bounded training strategies only on a separate development set; final sealed exam used once, no feedback into tuning.
Evaluate held-out task competence and preservation of solved tasks, not loss alone.
Verify source bytes, attribution, negation, relation direction and overlap independently; do not infer scientific truth from abstracts or use disclosed exam cases for training.
TRINITY may advise and review; deterministic truth checks are limited to their validated domain; independent reviewed acceptance remains mandatory.
Use isolated CPU research artifacts; no production checkpoint replacement or autonomous deployment.
Audit cross-repository source-to-consumption receipts and scheduled runs separately; record actual recovery only when observed, without credential or permission changes.
